# sreagent_slos (Data Source)

Every slo row, read-only. A service level objective over one SLI.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sreagent_slos" "all" {}

# Filter in HCL.
output "slos_below_three_nines" {
  value = [for s in data.sreagent_slos.all.items : s.name if s.target < 99.9]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource key the list was read from.
- `items` (Attributes List) The rows. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
- `truncated` (Boolean) True when the API returned as many rows as its cap and may hold more.

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The row's identifier on the platform.
- `name` (String) Shown on the SLO pages.
- `sli_id` (String) The indicator. Changing it replaces the SLO.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status; changed in the app.
- `target` (Number) The objective, for example 99.9.
- `window_days` (Number) The rolling window; defaults to 30.
